property_summary: For any block height N at which a guess was locked in (stored block B), settle() must revert when called at N == B, i.e. the guard requires block.number > guesses[msg.sender].block; the buggy `>=` version allows settle at N == B and therefore does not revert (or, if the guess matches blockhash(B), pays out 2 ether) in the same block as the stored block, violating the reference's strict-greater-than requirement.
change_summary: Change the settle guard from block.number > guesses[msg.sender].block to block.number >= guesses[msg.sender].block, allowing settlement in the same block as the recorded guess block.
